Class EditorActivityPoller

java.lang.Object
com.example.bluej.EditorActivityPoller
public class EditorActivityPoller extends Object
Every few seconds, reads the text length of each open editor and passes the numbers to the ActivityMonitor, which decides what counts as an edit or idle time. Uses a JavaFX Timeline so the editors are only read on BlueJ's own user-interface thread.
